aggregateSql: select now() as observed_at, (select count(*) from public.events) as total_events, (select count(*) from public.event_occurrences) as total_occurrences, (select count(*) from public.event_occurrences where starts_at > now()) as future_occurrences, (select count(*) from public.event_occurrences o join public.events e on e.id = o.event_id where o.starts_at > now() and o.status::text = 'scheduled' and e.status::text = 'published') as future_published_scheduled
